initiative: Email empresarial — permisos relacionales, auditoría y controles de seguridad

review_scope.rbac: PASS__Authorize plus RequierePermiso(Configurar Crear/Ver); RequierePermiso resolves the requested tenant through TenantPermissionContext and verifies the relational role grant server-side
review_scope.tenant_anti_idor: PASS__route tenant must equal X-Empresa-Id authority and EmailEmpresarialService revalidates active membership; repository lookups are EmpresaId-scoped
review_scope.idempotency: PASS__EmpresaId plus Idempotency-Key; replay of same request returns durable row, conflicting payload fails closed
review_scope.audit: PASS__durable create emits AuditoriaService metadata after persistence; audit payload excludes recipient, subject/body and idempotency key and retains safe identifiers/correlation
review_scope.correlation: PASS__CorrelationIdMiddleware establishes validated/generated TraceIdentifier and API ProblemDetails returns traceId without exposing internal errors
review_scope.health_observability: PASS__global health/live endpoints and request/security middleware remain active in Program.cs; no deploy or provider mutation required
review_scope.bounded_query: PASS__pagination 1..100, optional enum state and normalized correlation filter
